page_title: EIN 1-3 LEV | Eintracht Frankfurt v Bayer Leverkusen 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' 1 - 3 Goal! Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) scores after an assist by Ernest Poku that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:3.
90+2' A pass from Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by Janis Blaswich and the move breaks down.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
89' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) will deliver the corner kick.
88' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
87' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

87' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Janis Blaswich guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save. Now Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
84' Dennis Schmitt prepares a substitution. Nathaniel Brown is replaced by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
84' The players claim that Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) handled the ball and it seems they are right. A free kick has been awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
83' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Malik Tillman.
80' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.

79' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
79' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
77' Flag up against Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
76' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
74' The attendance is 59000.
74' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Bayer Leverkusen for a penalty. Play continues.
72' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Patrik Schick.
71' RED CARD! Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Robert Schroder. He can have an early bath.
71' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' Substitution. Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ritsu Doan walks off.
69' Dennis Schmitt has decided to make a change. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Mario Gotze.
69' A yellow card for a tackle by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt). Robert Schroder doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

67' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
64' Kasper Hjulmand decides to make a substitution. Martin Terrier will be replaced by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
64' Ezequiel Fernandez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen).
63' Caution goes to Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
63' Rough tackle by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Eintracht Frankfurt.
62' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
62' Bayer Leverkusen keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
59' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

59' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Substitution. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) in, Hugo Larsson out.
57' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Eintracht Frankfurt get a free kick.
56' Robert Schroder interrupts the game. One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick is awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
53' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sees a yellow card from Robert Schroder after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
51' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
50' 1 - 2 Goal! Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:2.
49' The corner kick from Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
49' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. It will be a corner kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.

49' The game is interrupted. Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a free kick.
48' The resulting free kick from Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
47' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Schroder saw the whole situation. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a free kick.
46' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Robert Schroder blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+5' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
45+5' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
45+4' Robert Schroder blows his whistle. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul after dangerous play. Eintracht Frankfurt are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45+3' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
45+3' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+3' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
44' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a rough challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a free kick.
41' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

39' A rebound falls kindly for Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
38' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
38' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
33' 0 - 2 It's 0:2! Christian Kofane feeds Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.

32' What an amazing save by Janis Blaswich! Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but fails.

30' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Schroder blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
29' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

28' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt manage to earn a corner.

26' 0 - 1 Alejandro Grimaldo is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 0:1.
26' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
26' A cross from Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
25' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
25' A lofted cross from Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
24' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
23' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
21' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught offside!
20' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
20' The Bayer Leverkusen players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Kaua Santos.
15' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
13' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a free kick.
11' The game is interrupted as Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged offside.
11' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
10' Bayer Leverkusen are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

9' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Schroder blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt in a dangerous position.
8' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt, play can continue.

7' There's a break in play and referee Robert Schroder must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Eintracht Frankfurt using VAR. This could be interesting!
5' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
5' One of the Eintracht Frankfurt players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
4' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) jumps into a tackle and Robert Schroder signals a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a free kick near the side line.
2' A cross by Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
1' The match has just started.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Robert Schroder.
